title: Viltrumite
description: Become Omni-Man or any other Viltrumite from Invincible and never go into aura debt. This mod is updated as a part of my video series on Youtube where I code it into reality (in Turkish).
body:
This mod requires [Viltrumite Flight 1.4.0+](https://modrinth.com/mod/viltrumite-flight) and is meant to be played in **third** person. 

_Please note that this mod is in an early stage of development. Many features are still being actively worked on and you may encounter bugs or incomplete mechanics._

Press **K** for the ability menu and **ALT** to swap skill sets. Drag and drop skills onto slots or right-click to remove them.

The mod automatically creates a viltrumitetextures folder inside your .minecraft directory and extracts the default skins (skin_omniman_2, skin_lucan, etc.) and the red cape into your folders if they are empty on startup. You can add your custom skins and capes but if you want other players to be able to see your custom textures, they need to have the same textures installed locally.

| Command | What it does | Who can use it? |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `/viltrumite skin <file name>` | Applies the specified mod skin to the character. (e.g., skin_omniman_2) | Everyone |
| `/viltrumite skin off` | Removes the active skin and reverts to the original look. | Everyone |
| `/viltrumite cape <file name>` | Equips a cape to the character. | Everyone |
| `/viltrumite cape off` | Removes the cape. | Everyone |
| `/viltrumite model default` | Sets the character model to normal (thick) arms. | Everyone |
| `/viltrumite model slim` | Sets the character model to slim arms. | Everyone |
| `/viltrumite power` | Grants Viltrumite powers to the player who ran the command. | OP (Admin) |
| `/viltrumite power <player>` | Grants Viltrumite powers to the specified player. | OP (Admin) |
| `/viltrumite depower` | Removes Viltrumite powers from the player who ran the command. | OP (Admin) |
| `/viltrumite depower <player>`| Removes Viltrumite powers from the specified player. | OP (Admin) |
